faqs.q: Who can apply for the Axis Bank MY ZONE EAZY Credit Card?
faqs.a: This card is available for Indian citizens aged 18 years or above. Applicants need to open a fixed deposit between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 25 Lakh. Tax Saver FDs, Flexi-Deposits, and FDs held by HUFs, trusts, societies, or companies are not eligible.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the card?
faqs.a: You can apply online through Axis Bank’s official website or visit a branch in person. You will need to submit self-attested ID proof, address proof, PAN, and the fixed deposit details to complete your application.

faqs.q: What are the rewards and benefits of this card?
faqs.a: The card offers 4 EDGE reward points for every Rs. 200 spent domestically, 25% cashback on movie tickets up to Rs. 1,000 per year, 15% discount at partner restaurants, and a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel purchases between Rs. 400 and Rs. 4,000.

faqs.q: What is the credit limit on this card?
faqs.a: The credit limit is based on your fixed deposit and can go up to 100% of the FD amount, giving you a secure way to start building your credit profile.

faqs.q: How do I activate my Axis Bank MY ZONE EAZY Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can activate the card online via mobile or internet banking, or by calling Axis Bank customer care and following the IVR instructions. Once activated, you can start using the card immediately for purchases and rewards.
